before.title: Philly I-76 Highway Sign Sticker, Schuylkill Expressway Philadelphia Decal, Basketball Fan Gift, Waterproof
before.description:
Philadelphia's favorite highway meets Philadelphia's favorite team. This interstate-shield sticker is inspired by I-76 (the Schuylkill Expressway, aka the "Surekill") and Philly basketball pride, made for anyone who has sat in traffic on the way to a game.

Choose your finish:
• Glossy: glossy laminated, waterproof vinyl
• Holographic: sparkly, light-catching finish (sparkle looks different in every light)

Drawn, designed, printed, and cut by me, who I am told is a human. No AI was used in the creation of these stickers.

Some photos are digital mockups showing the actual size. Colors and sparkle vary by screen and light.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any professional sports team or league.

before.title: Philadelphia Sticker Sheet, Holographic Glitter Philly Stickers, Soft Pretzel, Cheesesteak, Water Ice, Philly Gift
before.description:
It's a Philly thing! This sticker sheet has 9 hand-drawn Philadelphia-inspired stickers: a soft pretzel, a cheesesteak, a Philly-style water ice cup, a Philly candy bar, a highway sign, Independence Hall, a football wings piece, and more. Peel them off one at a time for laptops, water bottles, notebooks, planners, and phone cases.

Glossy laminated, waterproof vinyl, in a regular glossy or holographic glitter finish

Drawn, designed, printed, and cut by me, who I am told is a human. No AI was used in the creation of these stickers.

before.title: Philly Goose Sticker, Glossy Waterproof Die Cut Decal, Philadelphia Gift, Go Birds, Handmade
before.description:
Show your love for Philadelphia with this die-cut Philly goose sticker, a nod to one of the city's most iconic mascots, combined with hand-drawn lettering and artwork.

Choose your finish:
• Glossy: glossy laminated, waterproof vinyl
• Holographic: sparkly, light-catching finish (sparkle looks different in every light)

Great for:
Laptops, water bottles, skateboards, notebooks, coolers, and anywhere else that could use a little more Philly. It also makes a fun gift for the Philadelphia fan in your life, or anyone who moved away but never really left.

Some photos are digital mockups showing the actual size. Colors and sparkle vary by screen and light.
